item.title: Version 3.2.7 (构建 43)
item.description:
RateSync 3.2.7 带来以下重要更新与稳定性修复：

RateSync 3.2.7 brings key improvements and stability fixes:

新功能与修复 / Improvements and Fixes

  • 重构第三方播放器 AudioQueue 日志解析：优先提取真实解码源采样率，丢弃声卡硬件重采样输出率，统一普通与递归重试的会话过滤边界，修复网易云音乐、QQ 音乐等第三方播放器采样率误切问题。
  • 提升 Apple Music 真实无损解码器（ACAppleLosslessDecoder）日志优先级与时效校验，优先采纳更新的格式日志，避免受 AppleScript 静态模板值或上一首残留日志影响。
  • 修复桌面小组件双文件合并时清空记录丢失的问题，增加跨沙盒只读权限支持，提升小组件同步可靠性与刷新响应速度。
  • 优化采样率门控时序：换曲保护窗口与稳定性计时并行判断，稳定候选采样率生效耗时大幅缩短。
  • Refactor AudioQueue log parsing: prioritize genuine decoded source format from AudioConverter and unify session filter boundaries across retries, fixing incorrect rate switching for third-party players (NetEase, QQ Music).
  • Improve Apple Music decoder log freshness validation and prioritize ground-truth ACAppleLosslessDecoder logs over static AppleScript catalog values.
  • Fix widget state persistence and prevent cleared-state resurrection during state file merges, improving refresh responsiveness.
  • Optimize sample-rate gate timing: evaluate track-change guard window and stability persistence concurrently.

item.title: RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 5（预发布测试版）
item.description:
预发布测试版 / PRE-RELEASE BETA

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 5 修复第三方播放器 AudioQueue 日志重试边界与缓存过滤一致性问题，完善 Apple Music 解码日志时效校验，并修复小组件双文件合并时清空记录丢失的问题。

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 5 fixes AudioQueue retry boundary and cache filtering consistency for third-party players, improves Apple Music decoder log freshness validation, and fixes cleared-state resurrection during widget state file merges.

修复 / Fixes

  • 统一 AudioQueue 普通与递归重试的会话过滤边界，避免重试时放宽窗口引入旧转换日志抑制新曲目输出。
  • AudioQueue 缓存键区分过滤时间戳与播放代次，并增加日志缓存 TTL、代次清理与容量上限，防止跨曲目污染与内存累积。
  • Apple Music 解码日志校验增加真实曲目起点判断，优先采纳更新的格式日志，避免上一首残留日志覆盖当前曲目采样率。
  • 小组件持久化存储增加显式清空时间戳，防止单文件写入失败时旧状态被错误合并复活。
  • Unify AudioQueue session filter boundaries across normal and recursive retry paths to prevent stale converter logs from suppressing new track output.
  • Differentiate AudioQueue cache keys by timestamp and playback generation, and add TTL/generation eviction and capacity caps to avoid cross-track pollution.
  • Validate Apple Music decoder log freshness against genuine track start time and prioritize newer format logs over stale pre-track decoder logs.
  • Add explicit clear timestamps to widget state storage to prevent cleared states from being resurrected on partial write failures.

这是预发布测试版，暂非稳定版；如遇问题请通过 GitHub Issues 反馈。

This is a pre-release beta, not the stable release. Please report issues through GitHub Issues.

item.title: RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 4（预发布测试版）
item.description:
预发布测试版 / PRE-RELEASE BETA

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 4 修复第三方播放器（网易云音乐、QQ 音乐）AudioQueue 解码源采样率被声卡当前硬件率覆盖的问题，并完善 Apple Music 云端曲目真实解码器采样率优先级。

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 4 fixes an issue where the decoded source sample rate from third-party players (NetEase, QQ Music) via AudioQueue was superseded by the hardware output rate, and prioritizes ground-truth decoder logs over AppleScript defaults for Apple Music.

修复 / Fixes

  • 重构 AudioQueue 日志解析：优先提取 AudioConverter 中的真实源格式（lpcm），丢弃反映当前硬件输出率的 AudioQueueObject 日志，修复 48k 变 44.1k、96k 变 48k 的误切问题。
  • 提升 Apple Music 真实无损解码器（ACAppleLosslessDecoder）日志优先级，避免流媒体曲目受 AppleScript 静态 44.1 kHz 模板值影响。
  • Refactor AudioQueue log parsing: prioritize genuine decoded source format from AudioConverter and discard resampled hardware output rates.
  • Prioritize ground-truth Apple Music decoder logs (ACAppleLosslessDecoder) over static AppleScript catalog template values.

这是预发布测试版，暂非稳定版；如遇问题请通过 GitHub Issues 反馈。

This is a pre-release beta, not the stable release. Please report issues through GitHub Issues.

item.title: RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 3（预发布测试版）
item.description:
预发布测试版 / PRE-RELEASE BETA

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 3 修复 macOS 桌面小组件状态同步受沙盒权限拦截的问题，并优化切歌时采样率门控决策等待时序。

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 3 fixes widget state refresh issues caused by sandbox boundaries on macOS, and optimizes sample-rate gate timing during track changes.

修复与优化 / Fixes and Improvements

  • 修复小组件持久化存储路径被系统沙盒阻止写入导致小组件停滞不刷新的问题。
  • 新增跨沙盒只读权限与底层真实用户主目录解析，保证小组件与主应用稳定同步歌曲及采样率。
  • 优化切换门控等待逻辑：换曲保护窗口与稳定性计时并行判断，稳定候选采样率可更快生效（由约 5.5 秒缩短至 3.5 秒）。
  • Fix widget state persistence write blockage across sandbox boundaries that caused the desktop widget to stop updating.
  • Add cross-sandbox read entitlement and low-level user home directory resolution for reliable state synchronization.
  • Optimize sample-rate gate decision timing: evaluate track-change guard window and stability persistence concurrently.

这是预发布测试版，暂非稳定版；如遇问题请通过 GitHub Issues 反馈。

This is a pre-release beta, not the stable release. Please report issues through GitHub Issues.

item.title: RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 2（预发布测试版）
item.description:
预发布测试版 / PRE-RELEASE BETA

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 2 修复 Apple Music 切歌、暂停恢复和采样率证据更新时的时序问题，重点用于验证 96 / 48 / 44.1 kHz 切换稳定性。

RateSync 3.2.7 Beta 2 fixes timing issues in Apple Music track changes, pause/resume recovery, and sample-rate evidence updates. This build is intended to test stable 96 / 48 / 44.1 kHz switching.

修复 / Fixes

  • 防止旧的 AppleScript 超时或重试回调结束新一轮查询，避免同一首歌快速重试时串入旧结果。
  • AppleScript 超时后保留当前曲目已经确认的采样率，不再被不完整的日志候选错误覆盖。
  • 补齐 Apple Music 解码器日志中的明确位深证据，并改进 Atmos / 空间音频格式证据的后续更新。
  • Prevent stale AppleScript timeout and retry callbacks from completing a newer query.
  • Preserve a confirmed current-track sample rate when AppleScript times out instead of replacing it with incomplete log evidence.
  • Keep explicit decoder bit-depth evidence and improve later Atmos / spatial-audio evidence updates.

这是预发布测试版，暂非稳定版；如遇问题请通过 GitHub Issues 反馈。

item.title: Version 3.2.4 (构建 34)
item.description:
RateSync 3.2.4 修复部分安装、更新或重复构建环境下小组件无法刷新数据的问题。

RateSync 3.2.4 fixes widget data refresh issues in some installation, update, and repeated-build environments.

修复 / Fixes

  • 改进小组件状态桥接，统一传递歌曲信息、采样率和位深度。
  • 保留旧状态迁移，避免升级后丢失当前播放信息。
  • 修正打包校验，使其匹配当前小组件签名和状态容器方案。
  • Improved the widget state bridge for track metadata, sample rate, and bit depth.
  • Kept legacy state migration so updates do not lose the current playback information.
  • Updated package validation to match the current widget signing and state-container setup.

A small developer complaint: widgets are really hard to maintain.

item.description:
RateSync 3.2.3 新增多播放器接管规则，支持自定义播放器优先级和临时锁定来源。

RateSync 3.2.3 adds multi-player takeover rules with custom player priorities and temporary source locking.

新增 / New

  • 支持设置播放器优先级，多个播放器同时活跃时按优先级接管音频格式切换。
  • 支持临时锁定音频来源，避免其他播放器抢占。
  • 优先级和临时锁定入口放在实验性功能中。
  • Set player priorities and temporarily lock the active source to prevent competing players from taking over.

item.title: Version 3.2.2 (构建 32)
item.description:
RateSync 3.2.2 修复小组件无法添加、黑屏，以及部分情况下采样率和歌曲信息不同步的问题。

修复

  • 修复本地安装或更新后小组件扩展未注册，导致小组件从添加面板消失或显示黑屏的问题。
  • 修复 WidgetKit entitlement 在本地测试签名过程中丢失的问题。
  • 优化小组件状态合并，优先使用实时输出格式，分别处理音频格式和歌曲信息更新。
  • 修复 Apple Music 在无法获取活动播放器 PID 时误接收其他来源音频格式的问题。
  • 修复 Apple Music fallback 已有缓存后停止等待后续日志证据的问题，提升 Dolby 音频格式识别稳定性。

优化

  • 小组件添加面板描述跟随系统语言显示中文或英文。
  • 发布脚本增加 Widget entitlement、Hardened Runtime 和签名校验。

注：本版本为测试签名包，首次安装可能需要右键打开。
